clean_tensor_name: clean FSDP parameter or buffer names by removing wrapper prefixes like _fsdp_wrapped_module and checkpoint prefixes
_get_param_to_fqns: build a mapping from model parameters to their fully-qualified names for FSDP state dict serialization
_override_module_mixed_precision: override mixed precision on specified module classes by registering forward hooks that cast input and output dtypes
_apply_to_modules: traverse an nn.Module hierarchy in pre-order applying a function at each module with full prefix names
_assert_in_training_states: assert FSDP is in expected training states raising a descriptive ValueError with stack trace on failure
